# Count rows where the 'Film' column is not empty and the 'Notes' column does not indicate "Announced" or "Filming"
# We need to count films that have already been released/appeared in, so exclude rows with "Announced" or "Filming" in Notes
# Also ensure the film name is present (non-empty string)
appeared_films = df[~df['Notes'].str.contains('Announced|Filming', na=False) & df['Film'].notna() & (df['Film'] != '')]
answer = len(appeared_films)
